# Separate image-dialog insertion preferences from editing existing image state

The image test checks a persisted alternate-text radio choice across new insertion dialogs, including a canceled dialog. Editing an existing image chooses a radio from that image state, then preserves the edited choice when reopened. Keep those scenarios separate in test names and assertions. The test reads native radio selected state; it does not validate the final accessibility tree, screen-reader output or every generated alt attribute. This is static source evidence. No runtime, build, lint or live accessibility check was run. Full Bugzilla and Phabricator discussion remains pending.

Scope: Compose image dialog state tests.
